current_milestone.title: Expressive Capability
current_milestone.active_objective: Owner review rejected the technically valid but artistically unaccepted SHEESH Position artifact for revision; its 64 placements and rotations exactly reproduce scanned geometry, and the accepted Critic BLOCKER is preserved. Calibration now separates sourced MA2 software axis concepts and operator-verified Pan/Tilt convention from venue XYZ sign mapping. The current live scanner identity mismatches the Phase A fingerprint, so no FixtureType export/profile was bound. XYZ signs, stage/performance context and fingerprint-bound capabilities remain blocking. The bounded two-cycle ZEN revision runtime must not run until readiness passes. No writeback is approved; MA2_WRITES=0.

last_closed_task.result: Owner decision REJECT_FOR_REVISION is recorded. The completed six-role run is preserved unchanged as negative evidence: technical Position validation passed, all 64 placements and rotations equal scanned geometry, and Critic severity BLOCKER is accepted. Runtime now separates execution completion from design review, keeps writeback/Resolver/preview eligibility NO, and provides a max-two-cycle provider-authored revision path. Calibration against the fingerprinted Phase A snapshot remains BLOCKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE; no new provider run or MA2 write occurred.

next_acceptance_gate.why_it_matters: The owner rejected the current Position artifact for revision and accepted the Critic BLOCKER. Calibration now records MA2 software X/Y/Z concepts separately from venue sign mapping and records the operator's Show-scoped Pan/Tilt convention without deriving XYZ signs. The Phase A fingerprint does not match the current local scanner identity, so current-fingerprint FixtureType profiles were not exported or bound. XYZ sign mapping, stage/performance context and exact Show capability profiles remain blocking; fixture-object Pos units remain unknown.
dependencies: fingerprinted current Show snapshot and six validated role artifacts under the portable run state
next_acceptance_gate.next_review_condition: Supply independent current-Show XYZ sign mapping evidence (not derived from Pan/Tilt or generic MA2 semantics), enough venue orientation plus stage bounds/performance-zone evidence to interpret placements, and exact current-fingerprint FixtureType capability profiles. The current local Show identity must match the Phase A fingerprint or the calibration must be explicitly rebound through a separately approved fresh snapshot process. An operator-supplied Stage View evidence artifact is supported but not required when equivalent verified evidence exists. Reevaluate readiness before any ZEN revision inference. No spatial writeback is authorized.

human_review_decisions.limitations: Authorization is limited to the fingerprinted current Test Show, this SHEESH/Stage View experiment and Agent-owned objects. It does not authorize Patch, Address, Fixture ID, Fixture Type, Fixture 9999, unrelated objects or production Show writes.
No numeric-ID tie-break, equal Group level, cohort saturation, Group participation count, or dimmer level may be promoted into Lighting Design knowledge or a production strategy.

The completed SHEESH_CURRENT_SHOW_REDESIGN_001 run and its six role artifacts remain unchanged. The old status=COMPLETE describes technical execution only; the owner rejected the design and it is not writeback-approved.

evidence_results.limitations: Fingerprint confidence is PARTIAL rather than a native Show UUID. Stage/3D screen appearance was not captured. Numeric geometry is evidence only and carries no inferred artistic or stage-axis semantics.

All roles completed, but Position placements exactly reproduce the scanned 64 available geometry records; no geometry change is proposed. Position prose assigns units/physical meanings not established by the snapshot. Coordinate axes/units, physical mounting and current-fingerprint capability profiles remain UNKNOWN. Critic reports severity BLOCKER. Schema/provenance validity is not artistic approval. Codex did not edit ZEN artistic output; no spatial writeback occurred.

MA2 software concepts, current-Show machine facts, and operator/venue facts are separate namespaces. Official MA2 documentation does not supply this Show's XYZ sign mapping or exact scanned fixture Pos units. Operator Pan/Tilt directions are scoped to this Test Show and do not establish any XYZ sign. The supported loopback FixtureType export path was gated by the different live scanner identity and did not run; profiles remain unavailable for the Phase A fingerprint. UNKNOWN and PARTIAL remain valid. A new ZEN revision must wait for sufficient independent, fingerprint-bound placement and capability evidence.

This explicit Test Show authorization closes the resource absence blocker for SHEESH only. It does not establish a permanent palette, Group-to-Color role, B3 production authorization, or a Color design rule.
Fixture COLOR capability and generic typed CALL_PRESET syntax do not establish a current Show Color preset, applicability, palette, role, or B3 authorization.
